author: KEXP
description: On their latest release 'EARTH,' Portland-based krautrock band MØTRIK  chart a course through cosmic textures and hypnotic rhythms. Live on KEXP, they deliver a kaleidoscopic performance of "Weightless" and more.
title: MØTRIK performs "Weightless" & more Live on KEXP
